summary.zh: 计费透支：资金枚举追加 overdraft_draw 与 overdraft_receivable；付款主体新增每户透支软上限列（默认 0）；资金投影新增触发器保证透支投影非负；预占新增 admission 列（standard / post_delivery）并重建更新触发器使其不可修改。不改已有数据，不动资金。
summary.en: Billing overdraft: appends overdraft_draw and overdraft_receivable to the funds enums, adds a per-payer overdraft soft-limit column (default 0), projection triggers keeping the overdraft projection non-negative, and a reservation admission column (standard / post_delivery) frozen by the recreated update trigger. No existing data changes and no money moves.

verification.zh: 核对 PayerAccount 存在 overdraftLimitFen 且所有行为 0；FundsAccountProjection 有两个 overdraft 触发器；BillingReservation.admission 已有行均为 standard。
verification.en: Check that PayerAccount has overdraftLimitFen with every row at 0, FundsAccountProjection has the two overdraft triggers, and every existing BillingReservation.admission is standard.

verification.zh: 核对 FundsTransaction.kind 的枚举以 overdraft_draw 结尾。
verification.en: Check that the FundsTransaction.kind enum ends with overdraft_draw.

verification.zh: 迁移期间保持内部计费路由关闭：预占更新触发器删除与重建之间没有更新保护。
verification.en: Keep the internal billing routes off while migrating: there is no reservation update guard between dropping and recreating the trigger.
